changelog: - **A connection from a Source into a Converter no longer makes the Converter run short or lose resources.** A Source puts resources into Pools only, so such a connection never brought the Converter anything; it was still counted as one of its inputs. The Converter then ran at only part of its recipe from its other inputs, took them in full when its output had too little room and lost the difference, never ran at all when set to pull all, and in a chain of Converters made the members run at different parts with no notice. Under a conserved resource kind, a recipe could balance only by counting that connection. The connection now counts as no input: the Converter runs as it would without it, a conserved recipe is checked without it, and a Converter in a chain that is left with no input at all stops the chain before anything moves. The run still says that the Source pushes to something that is not a Pool. None of the bundled examples has such a connection. A Monte Carlo result saved before this change is shown as stale until it is run again (engine revision 18).
